content.about: Qatar is a small peninsula sticking into the Persian Gulf from Arabia. Most of it is flat desert, but its capital, Doha, has a skyline of striking modern towers. Natural gas has made it one of the richest countries per person. It hosted the football World Cup in 2022.

standout.text: Qatar hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup, the first held in the Arab world.

didYouKnow: Qatar has some of the world's largest natural gas reserves.
Khor Al Adaid, the "Inland Sea", is where desert dunes meet the sea.
The Museum of Islamic Art in Doha sits on its own island.
